source: Hand-written tape measurements by the shop (Bohohippychic), photo of the notebook page received 13 Nov 2026. Transcribed by hand; the photo itself is not in the repo.
method: Garment lying flat. Every girth is the flat width x 2. waistRelaxedCm = waistband relaxed; waistStretchedCm = waistband pulled to its comfortable limit; hipCm = full girth at the hip line of the shop's sketch; hemSweepCm = full hem girth; lengthCm = waistband to hem, flat, front and back equal.
transcriptionNotes: Size 8 hem: the page first said flat 137 cm / 274 cm, struck through and corrected to flat 115 cm / 230 cm. A stale 'x2 = 279 cm' remains on the flat line. 230 cm is used (it also fits the 248 and 260 of the other sizes).
Size 10 hem: flat 124 cm with an overwritten digit; the total on the page is 248 cm, which matches.

Hip steps are uneven: 112 -> 122 (+10 for one size) -> 126 (+4 for two sizes). Not corrected here. The hip line of an A-line skirt is not a fixed seam, so the measuring height may have differed per size; ask the shop at what distance below the band the hip was measured.
Sizes 12 and 16 were not measured. Any value for them is interpolated (12, between 10 and 14) or extrapolated (16) and must be labelled so.
